programme.title: Pix E Leo
programme.desc: Vem conhecer a Pix, uma pequena raposa animada e brincalhona, e o seu melhor amigo Leo, um leão dorminhoco e curioso. Segue as suas aventuras engraçadas na selva, enquanto eles riem, brincam e aprendem sobre o mundo que os rodeia. Eles vão conhecer os seus vizinhos animais, explorar ambientes diferentes e descobrir que, seja qual for o conflito, poderão sempre contar um com o outro.

programme.title: Maya And Yaya
programme.desc: Bem-vindo ao mundo divertido e corajoso da Maya e Yaya, dois elefantes de plasticina com personalidades muito distintas. As duas amigas que se apoiam e incentivam mutuamente, enquanto ultrapassam os obstáculos e diferenças. Maya e Yaya resolvem as suas diferenças com bondade e empatia. Provavelmente, as amigas iniciam um desafio ou competição, mas no fim partilham sempre um abraço.

programme.title: Agência De Detetives Da Zeina
programme.desc: Um objeto, tão familiar, do dia a dia chega à porta de Zeina esquecendo-se da sua utilidade. Ao procurarem a resposta, Zeina e o seu melhor amigo Roy inventam um novo uso hilariante para o objeto surpreendido. Enquanto todos se divertem imenso com a sua nova utilidade, é-lhes revelado o verdadeiro uso do objeto.

A série coloca a frase “se não conseguires à primeira, volta a tentar outra vez (vezes sem conta)” sob outra perspectiva.

programme.title: Olha O Que Encontrei

A história desenrola no quarto assim como na imaginação do menino, onde cada objeto se transforma em algo divertido e surpreendente. Um sapato transforma-se num carro, um pedaço de papel num avião e muito mais! A série apresenta-nos a interação com pequenos objetos a par com a imaginação da criança, que pode transformar um objeto em algo maior do que a vida!.

programme.title: Pix E Leo
programme.desc: Vem conhecer a Pix, uma pequena raposa animada e brincalhona, e o seu melhor amigo Leo, um leão dorminhoco e curioso. Segue as suas aventuras engraçadas na selva, enquanto eles riem, brincam e aprendem sobre o mundo que os rodeia. Eles vão conhecer os seus vizinhos animais, explorar ambientes diferentes e descobrir que, seja qual for o conflito, poderão sempre contar um com o outro.

programme.title: Maya And Yaya
programme.desc: Bem-vindo ao mundo divertido e corajoso da Maya e Yaya, dois elefantes de plasticina com personalidades muito distintas. As duas amigas que se apoiam e incentivam mutuamente, enquanto ultrapassam os obstáculos e diferenças. Maya e Yaya resolvem as suas diferenças com bondade e empatia. Provavelmente, as amigas iniciam um desafio ou competição, mas no fim partilham sempre um abraço.

programme.title: Bem-Vindos À Ilha
programme.desc: Longe, numa pequena ilha viviam quatro amigos. Coco, o sábio coqueiro, Bucky o pedregulho curioso, Lily a pequena flor e Blossom, o feliz mamoeiro. Seria de imaginar que não aconteceria muita coisa numa ilha pequena e remota, mas a vida na ilha é cheia de alegria e emoção graças a visitantes ocasionais, como as simpáticas gaivotas que vêm limpar o oceano, a tartaruga que vem pôr ovos ou a abelha que vem à procura de pólen.

programme.title: Pix E Leo

Eles vão conhecer os seus vizinhos animais, explorar ambientes diferentes e descobrir que, seja qual for o conflito, poderão sempre contar um com o outro.

programme.title: Maya And Yaya

As duas amigas que se apoiam e incentivam mutuamente, enquanto ultrapassam os obstáculos e diferenças. Maya e Yaya resolvem as suas diferenças com bondade e empatia. Provavelmente, as amigas iniciam um desafio ou competição, mas no fim partilham sempre um abraço.

programme.title: Agência De Detetives Da Zeina

Enquanto todos se divertem imenso com a sua nova utilidade, é-lhes revelado o verdadeiro uso do objeto.

programme.title: Bem-Vindos À Ilha

Seria de imaginar que não aconteceria muita coisa numa ilha pequena e remota, mas a vida na ilha é cheia de alegria e emoção graças a visitantes ocasionais, como as simpáticas gaivotas que vêm limpar o oceano, a tartaruga que vem pôr ovos ou a abelha que vem à procura de pólen.

programme.title: Pix E Leo
programme.desc: Vem conhecer a Pix, uma pequena raposa animada e brincalhona, e o seu melhor amigo Leo, um leão dorminhoco e curioso. Segue as suas aventuras engraçadas na selva, enquanto eles riem, brincam e aprendem sobre o mundo que os rodeia. Eles vão conhecer os seus vizinhos animais, explorar ambientes diferentes e descobrir que, seja qual for o conflito, poderão sempre contar um com o outro.

programme.title: Maya And Yaya
programme.desc: Bem-vindo ao mundo divertido e corajoso da Maya e Yaya, dois elefantes de plasticina com personalidades muito distintas. As duas amigas que se apoiam e incentivam mutuamente, enquanto ultrapassam os obstáculos e diferenças. Maya e Yaya resolvem as suas diferenças com bondade e empatia. Provavelmente, as amigas iniciam um desafio ou competição, mas no fim partilham sempre um abraço.

programme.title: Agência De Detetives Da Zeina
programme.desc: Um objeto, tão familiar, do dia a dia chega à porta de Zeina esquecendo-se da sua utilidade. Ao procurarem a resposta, Zeina e o seu melhor amigo Roy inventam um novo uso hilariante para o objeto surpreendido. Enquanto todos se divertem imenso com a sua nova utilidade, é-lhes revelado o verdadeiro uso do objeto.

programme.desc: La perdiz roja está considerada como la reina de la caza menor. Su escasez, en estado salvaje la convierte en una de las aves más demandadas en todo el territorio nacional.

programme.title: Play Pesca T1 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: En Navarra y el Pais Vasco, el ciervo rojo se ha aclimatado de manera espectacular desde su reintroducción con ejemplares procedentes del interior peninsular.

programme.title: A Câmara T1 - Ep. 8
programme.desc: La serie de pesca a mosca más pura. El famoso festival de cine de pesca a mosca nacido en Canadá llega por fin al canal caza y pesca Tv. Los mejores documentales de pesca premiados.

programme.title: Certeros Ballesteros: Jabalíes, Piparras Y Zorzales
programme.desc: As águas históricas do Canal do Panamá dão-lhe a oportunidade de viver uma grande aventura de pesca num local remoto e fascinante. Ao longo dos anos, as espécies de água salgada entraram no Lago Gatun e adaptaram-se perfeitamente, de modo que num dia de pesca pode capturar, para além das espécies do sargento, espécies como o Robalo, o Jurel, a Corvina e o Sabalo Real.

programme.title: Pesca Y Chef T2 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Cuando el terreno es sucio, los escurridizos conejos apenas nos dan unos segundo para el dispáro, son los tiros a tenazón, tiros instintivos sin apenas tiempo para apuntar.

programme.title: American Fishing T1 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Hermanos errantes (Dropped en Inglés) es una serie de televisión de estilo documental que sigue a los hermanos Chris y Casey Keefer mientras intentan sobrevivir en zonas remotas durante 30 días. El programa pone a prueba las habilidades de caza, pesca y supervivencia de los hermanos en entornos hostiles.

programme.title: Panamá, Águas Para Pescasub
programme.desc: Se dice del markhor que es el más bello animal que puebla las cumbres asiáticas. Para muchos es el grial de la caza de montaña. En Tayikistán, desafiando escarpadas laderas y un clima adverso, intentamos conseguir uno de los más grandes trofeos de este exclusivo animal.

programme.title: Berreia Aberta No Principado
programme.desc: En Asturias, la caza del jabalí con perros de rastro es una modalidad tradicional practicada por auténticos apasionados. En esta ocasión acompañamos a una cuadrilla que caza en varios lotes bañados por el rio Narcea, famoso por sus salmones.

programme.title: Boreale, Vivencias De Un Guía De Caza T5 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Viajámos até às barragens da Andaluzia para experimentar a técnica do jig com Humberto Gacio. Estas iscas são infalíveis com dois dos predadores mais desportivos que temos nas nossas águas.

programme.title: Batidas Jabalineras A Orillas Del Narcea
programme.desc: Un grupo de cazadores portugueses lleva varios lustros cazando la paloma Torcaz en la provincia de Madrid. Expertos cimbeleros prefieren la calidad a la cantidad saboreando cada paloma entrando en plaza.

programme.title: The Annual Fly Fishing Film Tour 2022 T1 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: La caza y cobro en agua requieren de un entrenamiento específico que comienza desde temprada edad. Los juegos en el agua son el mejor estimulo para conseguir que nuestro perros de caza se desenvuelva bien con el liquido elemento.

programme.title: Max Predators Fishing T3 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Kike Calleja conduce este programa que muestra distintas técnicas de pesca sin muerte y la biodiversidad de los ríos de la península. Para ello, cuenta con imágenes grabadas en 4K y ''slow motion'' tomadas desde drones, cámaras subacuáticas y helicópteros.

programme.title: É Assim Que Somos: O Ocaso Da Enguia Juvenil
programme.desc: Uma equipa do canal ¿Caça e Pesca¿ viaja até à Bolívia para conhecer uma parte da amazónica boliviana. Vamos viajar mais concretamente desde Stª Cruz até uma localidade indígena chamada Versalles que antigamente se dedicava exclusivamente à exploração da borracha e à pesca. De há poucos anos para cá encontram-se envolvidos num projeto para reorganizar o modo de vida da comunidade com um ambicioso guia de pesca e natureza.

programme.title: Hermanos Errantes T7 - Ep. 9
programme.desc: En este episodio os traemos un pequeño gancho muy curioso en Alagón (Zaragoza). Acompañamos a la sociedad del pueblo a resacar en las zarzas y cañas de la ribera del río Ebro. En ocasiones el jabalí no tiene más escape que 'embarcarse' y cruzar el río a nado. Sin duda una cacería muy curiosa y diferente.

programme.title: Río Salvaje Con Kike Calleja T6 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Nacho Contreras está a realizar um dos seus sonhos: pescar na Flórida. Este estado americano é, indiscutivelmente, um dos destinos mais atrativos para os pescadores de todo o mundo. A sua grande variedade de espécies marinhas e ecossistemas, juntamente com o elevado nível de profissionalismo na pesca desportiva, torna esta experiência verdadeiramente única.

programme.title: Hermanos Errantes T7 - Ep. 9
programme.desc: En este episodio os traemos un pequeño gancho muy curioso en Alagón (Zaragoza). Acompañamos a la sociedad del pueblo a resacar en las zarzas y cañas de la ribera del río Ebro. En ocasiones el jabalí no tiene más escape que 'embarcarse' y cruzar el río a nado. Sin duda una cacería muy curiosa y diferente.

programme.title: American Fishing T1 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: En el Parque Regional de la Cuenca Alta del Manzanares encontramos la finca Suerte Ampanera. Allí aparte de la explotación ganadera se lleva a cabo una ejemplar labor de conservación de especies amenazadas.

programme.title: Momento Spinning T2 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: Cuando el terreno es sucio, los escurridizos conejos apenas nos dan unos segundo para el dispáro, son los tiros a tenazón, tiros instintivos sin apenas tiempo para apuntar.

programme.title: De Viagem: O Sonho Americano
programme.desc: En Asturias, la caza del jabalí con perros de rastro es una modalidad tradicional practicada por auténticos apasionados. En esta ocasión acompañamos a una cuadrilla que caza en varios lotes bañados por el rio Narcea, famoso por sus salmones.

programme.title: Play Pesca T1 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: En Navarra y el Pais Vasco, el ciervo rojo se ha aclimatado de manera espectacular desde su reintroducción con ejemplares procedentes del interior peninsular.

programme.title: Batidas Jabalineras A Orillas Del Narcea
programme.desc: As águas históricas do Canal do Panamá dão-lhe a oportunidade de viver uma grande aventura de pesca num local remoto e fascinante. Ao longo dos anos, as espécies de água salgada entraram no Lago Gatun e adaptaram-se perfeitamente, de modo que num dia de pesca pode capturar, para além das espécies do sargento, espécies como o Robalo, o Jurel, a Corvina e o Sabalo Real.

programme.title: O Tera Na Primavera
programme.desc: Panamá esconde algumas das águas mais selvagens e espetaculares para a pesca submarina e os nossos aventureiros estão prontos para as descobrir. Entre mergulhos ao limite e capturas impressionantes de amberjacks, cada dia transforma-se num desafio inesquecível. Uma viagem cheia de ação, emoções intensas e paisagens tropicais únicas.

programme.title: The Dog Academy T2 - Ep. 6

programme.title: The Dog Academy T2 - Ep. 7
programme.desc: Graham e eram os melhores amigos, até ter chegado Leia, a lulu da Pomerânia. Agora, não se suportam. O jovem casal Ellie e Sam vive numa zona de guerra canina, tendo de manter os três cães separados. Victoria tem algumas verdades difíceis de ouvir para lhes transmitir.

programme.title: O Cão Ideal T1 - Ep. 14

programme.title: O Cão Ideal T1 - Ep. 15
programme.desc: Beverley Mahood conhece a família Sweeney que está à procura de outro cachorrinho para completar a família. Os Sweeney visitam o Labrador retriever, o cavalier King Charles spaniel e o border collie. As crianças apaixonam-se por todos os cachorrinhos, o que torna a decisão difícil para todos.

programme.title: Blanca Cocina Con Air Fryer - Ep. 6

programme.title: Cozinhas À Medida T1 - Ep. 6

A madeira clara traz conforto, a luz natural é aproveitada ao máximo, e cada solução, desde a arrumação invisível aos eletrodomésticos embutidos, tudo contribui para um espaço eficiente, sereno e pronto a viver.

It aims to connect people, cultures and societies across the East and the West. The program features dynamic designs, fast pace and rich visuals to keep viewers engaged. It also makes use of trending topics online, while focusing on what’s relevant in China and the world.

programme.title: The Contractor: Mercenário
programme.desc: Após ser dispensado das Forças Especiais do Exército e perder a pensão e o seguro de saúde, James Harper, endividado e com a família para sustentar, assina contrato com a uma equipa militar privada. Só que quando primeira missão corre mal, ele torna-se um alvo a abater.

programme.title: Vem Ao Papá
programme.desc: Após receber uma carta enigmática do seu pai, que não vê desde os cinco anos, Norval viaja para ir ter com ele, na esperança de que esta seja uma oportunidade para se reaproximarem. Mas será que se ele soubesse a verdade sombria sobre o seu progenitor, ele o teria reencontrado?

programme.title: Wilde
programme.desc: A história de Oscar Wilde, o genial poeta e dramaturgo, que vê a sua vida virada do avesso quando percebe que é homossexual.

programme.title: Sin City: Mulher Fatal
programme.desc: Alguns dos cidadãos mais duros e resistentes da brutal metrópole que é Sin City cruzam-se com alguns dos seus habitantes mais sanguinários, em histórias de vingança e redenção.

programme.title: É Demais Para Mim
programme.desc: Mesmo tendo com uma doença que lhe deixará pouco tempo de vida, Marta é uma menina órfã e alegre que decide encontrar alguém que se apaixone por ela. E quando conhece Arturo numa festa, é amor à primeira vista. Mas nem tudo vai correr como ela espera…

programme.title: Bernie, O Golfinho
programme.desc: Na Florida, dois irmãos encontram um golfinho separado da família e com queimaduras solares que acabam por ajudar, mas acabam também por descobrir um plano que pode destruir a praia e o lar do seu novo amigo.

programme.title: Bernie, O Golfinho 2
programme.desc: Kevin e Holly estão muito felizes por o golfinho Bernie estar de volta. Só que o seu velho inimigo Winston também está de regresso e quer raptar o inteligente cetáceo, o que vai obrigar os dois irmãos a fazerem de tudo para o salvar.

programme.title: O Pequeno Vampiro
programme.desc: Rudolph é um vampiro de 13 anos cujo clã é ameaçado por um reputado caçador de sugadores de sangue. Felizmente, ele conhece um humano da mesma idade, que o vai ajudar na sua luta de convencer os humanos e os vampiros a deixarem para trás os preconceitos e a trabalharem juntos.

programme.title: Pára, Ou A Mamã Dispara!
programme.desc: Joe Bornowski, sargento da polícia de Los Angeles, vê a sua vida virada do avesso quando a sua adorável mãe chega à cidade para uma curta visita, testemunha um crime e envolve-se de tal maneira numa perigosa investigação policial que acaba por se tornar na sua parceira.

programme.title: Para Roma Com Amor
programme.desc: Um casal em lua de mel, um arquiteto que regressa à rua onde viveu em estudante, um homem que se torna uma celebridade da noite para o dia e um diretor funerário tenta cumprir o sonho de ser cantor de ópera: quatro histórias que se cruzam na gloriosa cidade de Roma.

programme.title: Gémeos
programme.desc: Um homem inocente mas fisicamente perfeito vai em busca do irmão gémeo, que afinal é um vigarista careca e de pequena estatura.

programme.title: O Melhor Homem
programme.desc: Um grupo de mercenários toma o controlo do hotel de um resort remoto durante um casamento e cabe ao padrinho, ao noivo e ao seu melhor amigo bêbado tentarem deter os terroristas e salvar os reféns.

Quando uma arma ultrassecreta cai em mãos erradas, a agente da CIA Mason “Mace” Brown terá de unir forças com a sua rival Marie, com a antiga aliada do MI6 Khadijah e ainda com a hábil psicóloga colombiana Graciela, numa perigosa missão na qual terão de enfrentar a misteriosa Lin Mi Sheng.

programme.title: Na Corda Bamba
programme.desc: Há muito tempo, Rick Jarmin testemunhou contra um grupo de criminosos e desde então tem vivido escondido ao abrigo do Programa de Proteção de Testemunhas. Mas tudo se complica quando ele dá de caras com a antiga namorada, e ela reconhece-o...

programme.title: Braven
programme.desc: Quando Joe Braven se vê confrontado com um grupo de perigosos traficantes de droga na sua cabana isolada nas montanhas, ele vai ter de fazer tudo o que estiver ao seu alcance para proteger a sua família.

programme.title: Zona De Perigo
programme.desc: Abby Trent é uma agente da CIA que gere uma prisão clandestina de alto risco. Quando capturam Hatchet, o homem mais perigoso do mundo e um mestre na arte da fuga, ele inicia um jogo sangrento, eliminando os oficiais um a um. Abby descobre que está rodeada de traidores. Em quem pode confiar?

programme.title: A Quadrilha Selvagem
programme.desc: Em 1913, na fronteira entre os EUA e o México, um grupo de foras-da-lei de idade avançada procura fazer um último golpe e percebe que todo o mundo em que viveram, o do velho Oeste, está a mudar e desaparecer à sua volta.

programme.title: Daniel: Amizade Aterradora
programme.desc: Luke é um jovem perturbado que acaba de entrar na universidade. Para conseguir lidar com um violento trauma familiar, ele ressuscita o seu amigo imaginário de infância, Daniel, sem perceber o quão perigoso ele é.

programme.title: Marighella
programme.desc: ´É maoísta, trotskista ou leninista?´ Carlos Marighella só tem uma resposta para esta questão: ´Sou brasileiro´. Depois do golpe de Estado que derrubou um governo legitimamente eleito em 1964 e pôs uma ditadura militar no poder, Marighella conduz um grupo de jovens à resistência armada.

programme.title: Pára, Ou A Mamã Dispara!
programme.desc: Joe Bornowski, sargento da polícia de Los Angeles, vê a sua vida virada do avesso quando a sua adorável mãe chega à cidade para uma curta visita, testemunha um crime e envolve-se de tal maneira numa perigosa investigação policial que acaba por se tornar na sua parceira.

programme.title: Lá Vamos Nós Outra Vez!
programme.desc: Para animar a mãe da tristeza do pai a ter deixado, Rose e Alice decidem levá-la de férias por uma semana. Só que as irmãs têm visões da vida muito diferentes e formas muito distintas de tentar animar a mãe, pelo que o caos se vai instalar entre o trio.

programme.title: Por Água Abaixo
programme.desc: Roddy St. James é um rato sofisticado que vive uma vida mimada de animal de estimação num apartamento chique de Kensington. Porem, tudo vai mudar quando ele cai pelo cano abaixo, vai parar aos esgotos de Londres e tem de lidar com um mundo novo para poder regressar a casa…

programme.title: Ela Disse
programme.desc: Megan Twohey e Jodi Kantor, duas repórteres do ´The New York Times´, lançaram uma das mais relevantes histórias dos últimos anos, que ajudou a lançar o movimento #MeToo, rompeu décadas de silêncio em torno do tema do assédio sexual em Hollywood e alterou a cultura americana para sempre.

programme.title: Gone - 12 Horas Para Viver
programme.desc: Jill Parrish está convencida que Molly, a sua irmã desaparecida, foi sequestrada pelo mesmo assassino em série de quem escapou no ano anterior. Mas será que Jill se encontra psicologicamente perturbada ou é a única que conhece a verdade, conseguindo encontrar Molly antes que seja tarde demais?

programme.title: Na Corda Bamba
programme.desc: Há muito tempo, Rick Jarmin testemunhou contra um grupo de criminosos e desde então tem vivido escondido ao abrigo do Programa de Proteção de Testemunhas. Mas tudo se complica quando ele dá de caras com a antiga namorada, e ela reconhece-o...

programme.title: O Informador
programme.desc: Peter Koslow é um ex-soldado das Operações Especiais que é recrutado pelo FBI para se tornar informador e derrubar o maior senhor do crime de Nova Iorque. Quando a operação corre mal, ele fica preso entre a máfia, a polícia e o FBI — e terá de escapar para salvar a sua família.

programme.title: A Mulher Que Viveu Duas Vezes
programme.desc: Um ex-detetive de San Francisco com medo de alturas é contratado para vigiar uma mulher misteriosa, por quem fica obcecado e que o arrasta para uma espiral de ilusão, culpa e opressão.

programme.title: Um Traidor Dos Nossos
programme.desc: Um casal de férias em Marraquexe vê-se envolvido nos planos de um oligarca russo para desertar para o ocidente. Entre a mafia russa e os serviços secretos britânicos, o casal é obrigado a fazer uma perigosa viagem por Paris, Berna e pelos cantos mais obscuros da cidade de Londres.

programme.title: Matando Salazar
programme.desc: Uma equipa de elite de agentes de combate à droga tem por missão proteger um barão do narcotráfico num hotel de luxo. Enquanto aguardam pela extração do criminoso, veem-se no centro de uma emboscada quando os antigos associados do traficante lançam um ataque cerrado ao local.

programme.title: O Hóspede
programme.desc: David é um soldado que se apresenta à família Peterson como amigo próximo do seu filho, que morreu em combate. Só que após acolher o jovem em casa, o casal começa a aperceber-se que há uma série de mortes que começam a assombrar a cidade, e que parecem estar todas ligadas à sua presença.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Kamal é um jovem belga de origem marroquina que decide partir para Raqqa para ajudar as vítimas da guerra na Síria, onde é forçado a juntar-se a uma milícia. Em casa, o seu irmão mais novo torna-se uma presa fácil para recrutadores radicais, que lhe prometem que irá reunir-se com o irmão.

programme.title: Europakonzert 1994 – Meiningen
programme.desc: The Berliner Philharmoniker, Daniel Barenboim and Claudio Abbado star at the Europakonzert 1994 in Meiningen, Germany, performing Ludwig van Beethoven’s Piano Concerto No. 5 and Johannes Brahms’ Symphony No. 2. Popularly known as the Emperor Concerto and composed in Vienna between 1809 and 1811, Piano Concerto No. 5 is Beethoven’s last completed piano concerto and often performed by star pianists such as Daniel Barenboim.

programme.title: Teatro Regio behind the scenes
programme.desc: Few Italian theatres can boast of being an absolute point of reference for national and world culture. The Teatro Regio in Turin is both a symbol of excellence in the national operatic tradition and a prestigious stage hosting operas, ballets, concerts, and musicals of great substance.

programme.title: Puccini - Madama Butterfly
programme.desc: Italian conductor Beatrice Venezi leads the Orchestre national de Metz Grand Est and the Choeur de l'Opéra-Théâtre de Metz Métropole in a performance of Giacomo Puccini’s tragic opera Madama Butterfly (1904). The story revolves around Cio-Cio-San, the young Japanese geisha ‘Butterfly’ who marries the visiting American officer Pinkerton. Faithfully awaiting his return, she cannot accept that Pinkerton has abandoned her.

programme.title: Liszt - Due Poemi Sinfonici
programme.desc: Franz Liszt (1811 - 1886) composed 13 symphonic poems, largely inspired by literary texts. The composer himself wrote piano duet arrangements for these pieces, showcasing his incredible ability of imitating a full orchestra on the piano. Liszt, one of the 19th century’s most important piano virtuosos, strongly influenced the further development of piano music.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Mozart - Piano Concerto No. 17, K 453
programme.desc: This performance of Mozart’s Piano Concerto No. 17, K 453 was recorded at the Imperial Schönbrunn Palace in Vienna and features soloist Dezsö Ránki and the English Chamber Orchestra, conducted by JeffreyTate.

programme.title: Stravinsky - Jeu de cartes
programme.desc: Iván Fischer conducts the Budapest Festival Orchestra in a concert recorded at the Béla Bartók National Concert Hall in Budapest, Hungary in 2015. The concert opens with Sergei Prokofiev's Overture on Hebrew Themes, Op. 34. After this, Thomas Zehetmair stars as solo violinist in Prokofiev Violin Concerto No. 2, Op. 63. The second part of the concert is features music by Igor Stravinsky.

programme.title: Le Grand Orgue in Concert
programme.desc: Current holder of “Great Organ of the Notre Dame,” Olivier Latry began his musical career when he enrolled in Gaston Litaize’s organ class at the Academy of Saint-Maur at the age of 16. In 1985, at 23 years of age, Latry was awarded the post of one of four “titulaires des grands orgues” of Notre Dame, Paris.

programme.title: Brahms - Violin Sonata No. 2, Op. 100
programme.desc: In this splendid 2013 concert from the Church of Verbier, Switzerland, Greek violinist Leonidas Kavakos and Chinese pianist Yuja Wang join forces to interpret three sonatas by Johannes Brahms. Leonidas Kavakos rose to fame in 1985, when he became the youngest musician to ever win the first price of the prestigious Sibelius Competition.

programme.title: How to get out of the Cage - A year with John Cage
programme.desc: The compelling documentary How to Get Out of the Cage (2012) by award-winning filmmaker Frank Scheffer presents an intimate portrait of John Cage (1912-1992), one of 20th century's most important composers.

programme.title: Liszt - Totentanz, S. 525
programme.desc: Russian pianist Dina Ivanova performs Franz Liszt’s Totentanz, S. 525, during the Solo finals of the 11th International Franz Liszt Piano Competition, held at TivoliVredenburg in Utrecht, the Netherlands. Totentanz (Dance of Death) is one of Liszt’s many works that reflect the Romantic composer’s fascination with death. The piece is a series of variations on the macabre Gregorian Dies irae theme.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Passion in premiere - Giovanni Maria Trabaci
programme.desc: A first: an Early Baroque passion which will be heard again for the first time in the modern age. Giovanni Maria Trabaci was a style pioneer who broke with the Neapolitan unison tradition and was the first composer to write a complete passion cycle. With Jean-Marc Aymes’s unerring nose for quality, this concert belongs at the top of your list of favourites.

programme.title: Testing Mozart
programme.desc: Testing Mozart is a 60 minute film about the Mozart effect; the power of Mozart's music to fight disease and increase the mental ability of listeners. It is common knowledge that cows give more milk and tomatoes grow bigger when Mozart is played, but what effect does his music have on humans?

programme.title: Beethoven - Violin Concerto, Op. 61
programme.desc: Bernard Haitink conducts the Berliner Philharmoniker at the Easter Festival in Baden-Baden, 2015. On the program is Ludwig van Beethoven's Violin Concerto, Op. 61. The award-winning Isabelle Faust is the soloist, and since her recordings with Claudio Abbado, she’s the first choice when it comes to this masterpiece.

programme.title: Bach - Preludes and Fugues And Alla variata BWV 989
programme.desc: At the age of eleven, Italian pianist Andrea Bacchetti (*1977) debuted with Italian chamber orchestra I Solisti Veneti under the baton of Claudio Scimone. He performed on international festivals and in prestigious concert halls worldwide. Besides, he appeared with several renowned orchestras such as Lucerne Festival Strings, Camerata Salzburg, and Prague Chamber Orchestra. In this recital, Bacchetti performs works of J. S. Bach.

programme.title: Brahms - Tragic Overture in D minor Op. 81
programme.desc: The Maggio Musicale Fiorentino (Florence Musical May) is Italy’s oldest opera and arts festival. It was founded in 1933 with the aim of presenting contemporary and forgotten operas. Over the years, the scope widened, and orchestral concerts have long been an integral part of the festival.

programme.title: Verdi - Otello
programme.desc: Based on a story by William Shakespeare, the Italian composer Giuseppe Verdi wrote the opera Otello. Stage director David Alden created his version of this tragedy for the Teatro Real, in Madrid. Renato Palumbo conducts the orchestra and chorus of the Teatro Real. The performance also features Gregory Kunde, Ermonela Jaho, and George Petean. Othello, the Venetian governor of Cyprus, returns to the island after a victorious campaign.

programme.title: Piano works by Rachmaninoff, Beethoven And Glazunov
programme.desc: Russian pianist Nikolay Lugansky has received world-wide praise for his interpretations of the music of Sergei Rachmaninoff. In this wonderful recital, the great pianist presents works by the Russian Romantic composer as well as Ludwig van Beethoven and Alexander Glazunov. Lugansky opens his concert with Beethoven’s Piano Sonata No. 14 in C-sharp minor, Op. 27 No. 2, ‘Moonlight’, followed by Alexander Glazunov’s Piano Sonata No.

programme.title: Mussorgsky - Night on Bald Mountain
programme.desc: Young Euro Classic is the world’s most important platform for international young orchestra musicians in the European classical music tradition, and for its development. For 17 days every summer, orchestras from all over the world perform at Berlin’s Konzerthaus, on Gendarmenmarkt. This performance features some highlights of the Young Euro Classic edition of 2016.

programme.title: Schumann - Piano Sonata No. 3, Op. 14
programme.desc: After recording all 32 Ludwig van Beethoven piano sonatas to celebrate the composer's 250th birth anniversary, celebrated Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz decided to record solo piano works by Robert Schumann. Schumann composed his Piano Sonata No. 3 in F minor, Op. 14 (a 'Concerto for piano without orchestra', in the words of music publisher Tobias Haslinger) in 1836. He dedicated it to piano virtuoso Ignaz Moscheles.

programme.title: The 12 Cellists - Documentary
programme.desc: Directed in 2012 by Enrique Sánchez Lansch, the documentary The 12 Cellists follows the 12 cellists of the Berlin Philharmonic Orchestra. Since 1972, this group is a staple of the international musical universe. Whether they play classical music, jazz, tango or avant-garde music, these talented musicians invariably enthrall audiences with the wide range of unique and bewitching sounds they produce with their cellos.

programme.title: Tchaikovsky - Symphony No. 5, Op. 64
programme.desc: In May 2019, the new principal conductor of the Gewandhaus, Andris Nelsons, presented Tchaikovsky’s Symphony No. 5 with his orchestra in combination with Shostakovich’s Violin Concerto No. 1 with outstanding violinist Baiba Skride as the soloist.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Chopin - Piano Concertos No. 1 And No. 2
programme.desc: Antoni Wit conducts the Warsaw Philharmonic Orchestra in performances of Chopin's Piano Concertos No. 1, Op. 11 and No. 2, Op. 21. Soloists are Nikolai Demidenko and Evgeny Kissin. After performing the first concerto, Demidenko encores with Chopin's Mazurka Op. 17/4. Kissin closes the concert with Chopin's Etude Op. 10/12 and the Waltz in E minor, Op. post. This concert was part of the celebration of Chopin's 200th anniversary in 2010.

programme.title: Brahms - Violin Concerto
programme.desc: Israeli violinist Itzhak Perlman and the Berlin Philharmonic perform Johannes Brahms' Violin Concerto (1833-1897) under the direction of Daniel Barenboim. After Beethoven's Violin Concerto, Brahms' piece is probably the most famous German Violin Concerto ever written. These two works have much in common, especially the tone in D major in which they were composed.

programme.title: Ueda - Someone Out There is Praying for Peace I
programme.desc: Italian conductor Andrea Vitello leads his Ensemble BIOS in a performance of ‘Someone Out There is Praying for Peace (Let Us Not Be the Reason), I’, by contemporary Canadian composer Rita Ueda. This piece is written for strings and tar, a traditional plucked string instrument of Persian music, played here by Saeed Mirzazadeh. Ensemble BIOS specializes in 20th and 21st century music.

programme.title: Mendelssohn - Violin Concerto, Op. 64
programme.desc: Sir Simon Rattle conducts the Berlin Philharmonic in the 2016 edition of the Europakonzert. This time, it takes place at the beautiful Baroque church of Røros, a Norwegian mining town whose intact picturesque old town makes it a UNESCO World Heritage Site. The talented Norwegian violinist Vilde Frang is the star soloist in Mendelssohn’s songful Violin Concerto, Op. 64, which she plays with warmth, elegance and effortless virtuosity.

programme.title: Berlioz - Symphonie Fantastique, Op. 14
programme.desc: Maestro Mariss Jansons conducts the Berlin Philharmonic in a performance of Hector Berlioz' Symphonie fantastique, Op. 14. This performance is part of the Europakonzert 2001, recorded at Hagia Irene in Istanbul, Turkey.

programme.title: Mozart Live from Beijing
programme.desc: On January 27, 2006, Chinese virtuoso pianist Lang Lang celebrated WA Mozart's birthday with a performance of the Piano Concerto No. 24 in the Forbidden City Concert Hall of Beijing with the China Philharmonic Orchestram directed by Long Yu. The concert hall is located inside the walls of the Forbidden City, in the beautifully maintained gardens of Zhongshan Park, directly adjacent to Tiananmen Square.

programme.title: The Pianists Keys
programme.desc: This documentary by Christoph Keller follows various participants and teachers participating in the International Summer Piano Academy.

programme.title: Verdi - Rigoletto
programme.desc: Riccardo Frizza leads the Orchestra and Chorus of the Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in a performance of Giuseppe Verdi’s tragic opera Rigoletto (1851). In 1850, Teatro La Fenice commissioned Verdi to compose a new opera. Verdi proposed Victor Hugo’s controversial play Le Roi s'amuse to his librettist Francesco Maria Piave.

programme.title: PIAM - Semi-final: Mendelssohn and Chopin
programme.desc: Acclaimed classical music talent scout Antonio Mormone (1930-2017) lives on as the name-giver of the Premio Internazionale Antonio Mormone (PIAM), awarded to the winner of the Italian music competition of the same name. The first edition of this competition, which was held in various venues in Milan from 2019 to 2021, was dedicated to the piano.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Baroque Christmas Concert
programme.desc: This splendid Christmas concert was recorded live from the Freiburg Cathedral in 1999. It features soprano Barbara Bonney, recognized worldwide for the clarity of her voice and the precision of her diction, and the baritone Matthias Goerne, one of the most promising singers of his generation.

programme.title: Haydn - Symphony No. 94, Hob. I:94
programme.desc: Joseph Haydn (1732-1809): Symphony No. 94 in G major 'Surprise'. Berliner Philharmoniker; conductor: Mariss Jansons. The European Concert has been a tradition of the Berliner Philharmoniker since 1991. The musicians commemorate the anniversary of the orchestra's founding on May 1st, 1882, playing in different European cities. This concert was recorded in the church 'Hagia Eirene' in Istanbul, Turkey.

programme.title: Beethoven - String Quartet No. 7 And 13, and Op. 133
programme.desc: Renowned French string quartet Quatuor Ébène marked the 250th birth anniversary of Ludwig van Beethoven (1770-1827) with a remarkable project: recording all of the great composer’s sixteen string quartets. For five years, violinists Pierre Colombet and Gabriel Le Magadure, violist Marie Chilemme, and cellist Raphaël Merlin immersed themselves in Beethoven’s 650 pages of sheet music.

programme.title: Schumann - Fantasiestücke, Op. 73
programme.desc: In Geneva, the city where she spent the most of her life, Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich invites her lifelong music partner, the cellist Mischa Maisky, to play in private chamber music. Between each piece, Martha opens up to her daughter Annie Dutoit, in an intimate interview that brings both their intimacy and the music.

programme.title: Napoli - Music's forgotten capital -I
programme.desc: In the summer of 2019, the Utrecht Early Music Festival explored the musical legacy of Naples: a cultural metropolis of contradiction and solidarity. In the documentary 'Napoli – Music’s Forgotten Capital', festival co-curator Thomas Höft unearths riveting tales from this multi-faceted city.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Works by Kindermann, Fischer, and Baal
programme.desc: Every year in late August, the renowned Early Music Festival takes place in the Dutch city of Utrecht. It is the world's largest festival focused on early music, attracting an audience of over 70 thousand visitors. Due to the corona pandemic, the 2020 edition of the festival took place in an alternative form, offering an alternative program that included live concerts as well as daily livestreams of concerts and archive recordings.

programme.title: El Sistema
programme.desc: El Sistema is a network of children’s and youth orchestras, music centres and workshops in Venezuela, in which more than 250,000 children and young people are currently learning to play an instrument. It was set up over thirty years ago by José Antonio Abreu, who was driven by a utopian vision of a better future.

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 4 in B-flat major, Op. 60
programme.desc: Les Dissonances is a collective of artists founded by violinist David Grimal in 2004. The conductorless ensemble consists of musicians from the most prestigious European orchestras, international soloists, and young talents. In this performance, Les Dissonances perform Ludwig van Beethoven’s Symphony No. 4 in B-flat major, Op. 60. Count Franz von Oppersdorff, who adored Beethoven’s Symphony No.

programme.title: Schumann - Carnaval, Op. 9
programme.desc: After recording all 32 Ludwig van Beethoven piano sonatas to celebrate the composer's 250th birth anniversary, celebrated Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz decided to record solo piano works by Robert Schumann. Schumann wrote Carnaval, Op. 9 in 1834–1835. It consists of 21 short pieces representing masked revelers at Carnival, a festival before Lent.

programme.title: Bach - Violin Sonata No. 3 (BWV 1005)
programme.desc: Celebrated German violinist Isabelle Faust performs J. S. Bach’s Sonata No. 3 in C major (BWV 1005). The work is part of the composer’s well-known Sonatas and Partitas for Solo Violin (BWV 1001-1006). Sonata No. 3 includes an extensive fugue in which Bach employs many contrapuntal techniques. In this wonderful performance, Faust shows her mastery of Bach’s technically challenging piece. This performance was recorded at St.

programme.title: Kristine Opolais Recital
programme.desc: Critics praise her, and the audience loves her. Kristine Opolais, the prima donna and the star of the New York Metropolitan Opera, performs in her home country Latvia. She gives a splendid concert with the Latvian National Symphony Orchestra, at the Latvian National Opera, in 2017. The program includes arias from operas that made Kristine an international star.

programme.title: Brahms - Tragic Overture in D minor, Op. 81
programme.desc: Manfred Honeck conducts the Berlin Philharmonic in a performance of Brahms' Tragic Ouverture, Op. 81 during the Easter Concert in Baden-Baden 2016.

programme.title: Anastasia
programme.desc: By popular demand, Canada's Ballet Jörgen reprises the tragic tale of the Russian Grand Duchess Anastasia, 10 years after the ballet's premiere and 100 years after Anastasia's story. Created by acclaimed choreographer Bengt Jörgen, the ballet is set to an original score for orchestra by Russian composer Ivan Barbotin.

programme.title: Chamber music by Janácek, Taffanel and Prokofiev
programme.desc: This chamber music concert is part of the ‘Solistas del Siglo XXI’ concert series of the Reina Sofía School of Music in Madrid. First, Quinteto Zéphyros performs Leoš Janácek’s Mládí (‘Youth’) for wind sextet. This is followed by French flautist Paul Taffanel’s Wind Quintet in G minor, performed by Quinteto Scarlatti de Casa de la Moneda. The program closes with Sergei Prokofiev’s Quintet in G minor, Op. 39, played by Quinteto Cosan.

programme.title: Franz in Vienna: Mozart and Schoenberg
programme.desc: Austrian conductor Franz Welser-Möst leads his Cleveland Orchestra in a performance of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s Divertimento No. 2 in D major, KV 131, and Arnold Schoenberg’s Variations for Orchestra, Op. 31, recorded at Severance Hall in Cleveland, USA. In addition, Welser-Möst takes a walk through ‘his’ Vienna, enlightening us on this musical capital that was home to both Mozart and Schoenberg. He contrasts the Divertimento No.

programme.title: Schubert - Four Impromptus, Op. 90: - I.
programme.desc: Roberto Prosseda (1975) performs Mozart's Piano Sonata No. 5 (KV. 283) and four Impromptus Op. 90 by Franz Schubert. The performance ends with Chopin's technically demanding Ballade No. 4, Op. 52. Prosseda is particularly noted for his performances of newly discovered works by Mendelssohn and has recorded a nine-CD series for Decca of the piano works of Mendelssohn.

programme.title: Mozart - Violin Concerto No. 5
programme.desc: Les Dissonances is a collective of artists founded by violinist David Grimal in 2004. The conductorless ensemble consists of musicians from the most prestigious European orchestras, international soloists, and young talents. In this performance, Les Dissonances play Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s Violin Concerto No. 5 in A major, K. 219, also known as the ‘Turkish Concerto’. Leading violinist Grimal features as the soloist.

programme.title: Schumann - Symphony No. 1 in B-flat major
programme.desc: German conductor Christian Zacharias leads the Orchestre national de Lille in a performance of Robert Schumann’s Symphony No. 1 in B-flat major, Op. 38, also known as the ‘Spring Symphony’. This optimistic work is written in 1841 and is the most performed of Schumann’s four symphonies. This concert was recorded at Auditorium du Nouveau Siècle in Lille, France, on June 16, 2017.

programme.title: IVC 2019 - Final: Duparc, Borodin et al.
programme.desc: Mezzo-soprano Esther Valentin (Germany, 1993) and pianist Anastasia Grishutina (Russia, 1988) perform Henri Duparc’s L’invitation au voyage; Aleksandr Borodin’s ‘Dlya beregov otchizni dal’noy’ (For the shores of thy far native land); ‘Fleur jetée’ from Gabriel Fauré’s Quatre melodies, Op. 39; Franz Schubert’s Die Liebe hat gelogen, Op. 23 No. 1 (D.

programme.title: Handel - Messiah, HWV 56
programme.desc: Composer George Frideric Handel’s oratorio Messiah, HWV 56 is his best-known work. He wrote this choral masterpiece in just 24 days in 1741. Following its premiere in Dublin in 1742, the work has been immensely popular. The oratorio’s three parts deal with the birth, death, and resurrection of Jesus Christ. Charles Jennens’ libretto is based on texts from the Old and New Testament.

programme.title: Dvorák - Rusalka
programme.desc: Bulgarian conductor Pavel Baleff conducts the Orchestra and Choir of the Opéra de Limoges in a performance of Antonín Dvorák’s lyric fairytale opera Rusalka (1900). The work’s libretto is written by Czech poet Jaroslav Kvapil. Rusalka, an elusive water nymph, falls in love with the Prince, who happens to swim in her lake. Rusalka longs to become human herself so that she can be together with the Prince.

programme.title: Waldbühne 2004 - Tchaikovsky night
programme.desc: The Berliner Philharmoniker and Lang Lang under the baton of Sir Simon Rattle.

programme.title: Modena - City of Belcanto
programme.desc: This documentary by Mark Perna shows the training and professional growth actions for opera singers, the promotion and enhancement of the cultural offer of the city and province of Modena and the maintenance and development of the Modenese musical tradition in the field of opera.

programme.title: Mozart - Requiem in D minor, K. 626
programme.desc: Daniel Harding leads the Orchestra and Choir of the Maggio Musicale Fiorentino and four vocal soloists in a magnificent performance of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s Requiem in D minor, K. 626. The soloists are soprano Christiane Karg, mezzosoprano Sara Mingardo, tenor Matthew Swensen, and bass Gianluca Buratto. The Austrian Count Walsegg commissioned Mozart to compose a Requiem in July 1791 to commemorate his late wife, Anna.

programme.title: Feira Semanal: Peso Da Régua
programme.desc: Peso da Régua, a terra que fala com o rio, brinda com o vinho e vive a Feira como se fosse uma festa popular. Uma Feira que parece feita em socalcos, onde cada produto tem história e cada feirante tem uma alma gigante. Aqui, o vinho mistura-se com o alho, o figo com o linho, o sotaque com a simpatia.Neste episódio do “Feira Semanal”, mergulhamos na alma vinhateira da feira do Peso da Régua.

programme.title: De Gente And De Vinha: A Vinha De Enforcado Nos Vinhos Verdes
programme.desc: De Gente And De Vinha, um retrato intimista do mundo vitivinícola, apresentado com o requinte e poesia do chef André Magalhães, percorre conversas e deambulações por entre quintas familiares, castas em extinção, tabernas e adegas centenárias.Dos lameiros férteis do Minho, a vinha trepou às árvores, subiu às ramadas e transformou-se em paisagem. Em Mancelos, a vinha de enforcado ergue-se como memória viva de uma forma de cultivo antiga.

programme.title: Documentário: Chefe Do Ano 2026
programme.desc: Há 36 anos que a mesma pergunta atravessa as cozinhas de Portugal: quem é o Chefe do Ano? Mais do que um concurso, é o palco onde um sonho se transforma em legado, o mesmo que revelou nomes hoje incontornáveis na gastronomia portuguesa, todos eles, um dia, apenas cozinheiros e cozinheiras com uma faca, uma ideia e a coragem de arriscar tudo.

programme.title: A Letra: Paulo Gonzo - 'Jardins Proibidos'
programme.desc: Num formato intimista de 11 minutos, o programa acompanha Margarida Pinto Correia em conversas próximas com músicos, centradas nas canções.A canção “Jardins Proibidos” foi lançada em 1992 no álbum Pedras da Calçada, o primeiro disco do artista inteiramente cantado em português. A canção, com música de Paulo Gonzo e Luís Oliveira e letra de Paulo Gonzo e Pedro Malaquias, tornou-se rapidamente um dos maiores êxitos da música portuguesa.

programme.title: Nova Oportunidade T1 - Ep. 31
programme.desc: NOVA OPORTUNIDADE é uma nova série dramática ambiciosa e de grande sucesso, com algumas das maiores estrelas da Turquia. A história centra-se em Deniz, uma mulher inocente que tem tudo o que poderia desejar na vida, até que o marido desaparece sem deixar rasto. Após perder tudo o que possuía, vê-se numa situação desesperada e enfrenta uma luta diária pela sobrevivência, necessitando de lutar pelo bem dos seus filhos e do seu pai idoso.

programme.title: O Jogo do Destino - Ep. 88
programme.desc: Bahar abre um curso profissional num bairro pobre para ajudar as donas de casa, e aí conhece Demir. O conflito entre ambos começa com uma confusão ao comprar uma sobremesa e num acidente de mota. Apesar da tensão, forma-se um laço. Quando Bahar fica presa num incêndio, Demir arrisca a própria vida para a salvar. Entretanto, Aysun planeia vingar-se de Harun, planeando casar com ele, matá-lo e começar uma nova vida com Demir.

Trocados à nascença por líderes da máfia, crescem sem conhecer as suas verdadeiras identidades. Anos mais tarde, os seus caminhos voltam a cruzar-se enquanto lutam pela justiça e pelo amor, enredados numa teia de segredos, traição e poder.

programme.title: Nova Oportunidade T1 - Ep. 36
programme.desc: NOVA OPORTUNIDADE é uma nova série dramática ambiciosa e de grande sucesso, com algumas das maiores estrelas da Turquia. A história centra-se em Deniz, uma mulher inocente que tem tudo o que poderia desejar na vida, até que o marido desaparece sem deixar rasto. Após perder tudo o que possuía, vê-se numa situação desesperada e enfrenta uma luta diária pela sobrevivência, necessitando de lutar pelo bem dos seus filhos e do seu pai idoso.

programme.desc: A história gira em torno de uma garota chamada Azra, que está estudando no exterior, na América, para se tornar cozinheira profissional, assim como seu pai.

programme.title: Segure Minha Mão T1 - Ep. 49
programme.desc: A história gira em torno de uma garota chamada Azra, que está estudando no exterior, na América, para se tornar cozinheira profissional, assim como seu pai.

programme.title: O Jogo do Destino - Ep. 93
programme.desc: Bahar abre um curso profissional num bairro pobre para ajudar as donas de casa, e aí conhece Demir. O conflito entre ambos começa com uma confusão ao comprar uma sobremesa e num acidente de mota. Apesar da tensão, forma-se um laço. Quando Bahar fica presa num incêndio, Demir arrisca a própria vida para a salvar. Entretanto, Aysun planeia vingar-se de Harun, planeando casar com ele, matá-lo e começar uma nova vida com Demir.

programme.title: Ressurreição: Ertugru T2 - Ep. 55
programme.desc: Na segunda temporada, a tribo Kayi alia-se aos clãs turcomanos para resistir à invasão mongol. Ertugrul é capturado e torturado, mas escapa e regressa para enfrentar a traição, o exílio e planos maquiavélicos. Expõe conspirações, resgata o seu filho, derrota Noyan e leva o seu povo para oeste para fundar um novo estado.

programme.title: jazzahead! 2022 - Ikarus
programme.desc: Annual trade fair, exhibition, and festival jazzahead! is one of the international jazz community's most important events. Hosted in Bremen, Germany, jazzahead! brings together musicians, bookers, agents, organizers, jazz experts, and music enthusiasts at the world’s largest jazz event. In 2022, jazzahead!

programme.title: jazzahead! 2024 - Linda Fredriksson Juniper
programme.desc: Annual trade fair, exhibition, and festival jazzahead! is one of the international jazz community’s most important events. Hosted in Bremen, Germany, jazzahead! brings together musicians, bookers, agents, organizers, jazz experts, and music enthusiasts at the world’s largest jazz event. In 2024, jazzahead!

programme.title: A$AP Rocky And A$AP Ferg - At The Hordern Pavilion
programme.desc: Big hits, booty dancing, stage dives, fan freestyles and of course, controversy, A$AP Rocky's debut Down Under tour had it all! At his sold-out Sydney show, hip hop's hottest star and 5000 rowdy fans got wild for the night at the Hordern Pavilion and we captured it all exclusively.

programme.title: Sarah Vaughan 'The Divine One' in 1958
programme.desc: Sarah Vaughan: Live in '58 And 64 features the Divine One in her prime, wrapping her sultry voice around jazz standards such as “Lover Man”, “Misty”, and “I Got Rhythm” and popular showtunes such as “Over The Rainbow” and “Maria”. One of the greatest voices of the 20th Century, her renditions of songs by Harold Arlen, Leonard Bernstein, Johnny Burke, the Gershwins, and Stephen Sondheim are pure diva magic.

programme.title: Libérica Arrels
programme.desc: Having played in New York with jazz icons Dave Liebman, Eliot Zigmund, Ari Hoenig, and Chris Cheek, Catalan bass player Manel Fortià now returns to his roots to reinvent traditional Catalan repertoire. Manel Fortià teams up with Antonia Lizana (saxophones), Pere Martínez (vocals), Max Villavecchia (piano), and Raphael Pannier (drums) to form ‘Libérica’, reimagining Catalan music and Flamenco through the eyes of a New York jazz musician.

programme.title: WOMEX 2018
programme.desc: Since 1994, World Music Expo (WOMEX) has been attracting musicians, agents, a great number of press agencies, as well as media companies from all over the world. Its main exposition event has been held in various locations throughout Europe, including Berlin, Brussels, Marseille, Stockholm, Seville, Cardiff, and Budapest. The 2018 edition of WOMEX was held in Las Palmas, Gran Canaria.

programme.title: Stift Festival: Suite del Ángel
programme.desc: Late August is traditionally the time for the annual Stift International Music Festival. Weerselo’s Stift Church and Oldenzaal’s ‘Hofkerk’ serve as venues for wonderful concerts of various young musicians from all over the world. The theme of the 2014 Stift Festival was “Divine and Demonic Passion”. Young musicians performed divine and demonic chamber music by composers such as Astor Piazzolla.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Les McCann: Live in New Orleans
programme.desc: Self-taught musician Les McCann became the international jazz superstar he is today after the release of his album “Swiss Movement” which he recorded in 1968 with the late Eddie Harris. Yet there is much more to this musician than that one record.

programme.title: Georgie Fame And the Blue Flames
programme.desc: Georgie Fame, known for 'Yeh, Yeh' and 'The Ballad of Bonnie and Clyde' makes a triumphant comeback with The Blue Flames. Georgie Fame and the Blue Flames was a popular band in the UK in the '60s, celebrated for its RAndB, soul, jazz, ska, and pop sounds. The training was largely inspired by ska, a popular musical style in Jamaican cafes in London at the time.

programme.title: Portrait: North Sea Round Town
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: Under the Surface - Live at Bimhuis 2018
programme.desc: Under the Surface is an improvisational jazz band formed by drummer Joost Lijbaart, vocalist Sanne Rambags, and guitarist Bram Stadhouders. Sanne Rambags, the youngest artist of the trio, is one of the few vocalists of her generation who able to improvise effortlessly, be it by using her voice as an instrument blending with the sounds of the band, or by performing her own poetry.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Sly Johnson And Nicholas V. - Tribute to Marvin Gaye
programme.desc: For 20 years, Sly Johnson, author, composer and performer of the Saïan Supa Crew, has been touring the French music scene with his soul, hip-hop and beat-box vocals. He leaves his machines in the studio for a tribute concert to one of the leading voices of the famous Motown label, Marvin Gaye. The singer was killed by his father, a pastor, the day before his 45th birthday.

programme.title: Episode 1: Thelonious Monk - Jazz Greats
programme.desc: The idiosyncratic pianist and composer Thelonious Monk (1917-1982) is one of the all-time greats of jazz. His music went largely misunderstood for the first 15 years of his career, after which he was rightly hailed as a genius, and received credit as a founding father of bebop.

programme.title: BIRDtv: Boogieball
programme.desc: Rotterdam’s ‘ BIRD’ is a club, café and restaurant with a live music programme that's deeply rooted in jazz, and also branches out towards soul, funk, hip-hop and electronic music as well. Its name ‘BIRD’ refers to the nickname of the legendary New York jazz saxophonist, bebop co-founder Charlie Parker (1920-1955). BIRD serves Neapolitan pizzas, good wines, no-nonsense beers and an all-round metropolitan rawness.

programme.title: Tony Bennett
programme.desc: Relive the magic of one of the most beloved crooners in music history in his prime: Tony Bennett! Recorded live in London’s Royal Albert Hall on March 2, 1974, this enchanting performance showcases Bennett's remarkable vocal prowess and charisma to full effect.

programme.title: Stingray PausePlay: Jazz in Duketown
programme.desc: We Pause and chat with local and international artists to get an in-depth look at their lives and music, they Play some amazing music in these, one-of-a-kind, live sessions! These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life.

programme.title: Mr. Phone Bone
programme.desc: The audience at the Montreal Jazz Festival in Canada was in for a treat on July 3, 1982, as a true musical innovator hit the stage: Jaco Pastorius, who transformed the electric bass into a formidable solo instrument. Combining intricate harmonics, fluid melodies, and unparalleled technical skill, Pastorius left a lasting impact on the music world.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: John Lee Hooker Live in Paris
programme.desc: In this 1970 performance at Maison de la Radio in Paris, France, American blues legend John Lee Hooker (voice and guitar) is joined by the masterful Carey Bell (harmonica), Joe Harper (bass), Lester Dorsie (drums), and Jimmy Dawkins (electric guitar).

programme.title: DJAZZ Portrait: EU Jazz Competition
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: Paradox Live: Philippe Lemm Trio
programme.desc: Innovative contemporary jazz and improvised music, the search for modernity, mind blowing sounds, rock and pop… Indeed PARADOX Tilburg goes beyond jazz, crossing musical boundaries into the unknown soundscapes of electronic music. Indie artists, blues veterans and jazz superstars all pour their hearts and souls at the Paradox.

programme.title: jazzahead! 2023 interview
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: Tango Extremo: Tango on the Tundra
programme.desc: Five musicians, in excess of 3000 miles, nine concerts, in thirteen days: in November 2015, the five-piece ensemble ‘Tango Extremo’ left the confines of its hometown, the Dutch city of The Hague, to travel through Russia. On the musicians’ jam-packed itinerary were performances in Moscow, Novosibirsk, Saratov, Tomsk, and Barnaul.

programme.title: Mezzoforte - North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. In 1986, famed Icelandic jazz fusion band Mezzoforte performed for over an hour at the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague.

programme.title: McCoy Tyner Trio live at Estival Lugano
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. McCoy Tyner’s first main exposure came with Benny Golson, being the first pianist in Golson’s and Art Farmer’s Jazztet.

programme.title: Kurhaus Scheveningen: Beets And Rosenwinkel
programme.desc: The Dutch world-class jazz pianist Peter Beets has shared the stage with jazz greats like Chick Corea, Wynton Marsalis, “Toots” Thielemans, Elvin Jones, George Coleman, Johnny Griffin, Benny Golson and John Clayton. From birth, Beets was surrounded by music: he heard classical music from his mother, who is a music pedagogue, and he heard jazz from his father, who has a great fan of Oscar Peterson and Art Blakey.

programme.title: Malta Jazz Festival
programme.desc: On July 20, 2018, double bassist Christian McBride presented his band ‘New Jawn’ at the Malta Jazz Festival. A five-time Grammy winner, McBride is one of the most requested, most recorded, and most respected figures in the music world today. Hailing from Philadelphia, this music luminary combines jazz, RAndB, pop/rock, hip hop/neo-soul, and classical.

programme.title: Move Over
programme.desc: In 1988, Dee Dee Bridgewater was one of the first great jazz singers to perform at the Jazz Festival in Ramatuelle. In 2016, the story seems to repeat itself as her daughter China Moses took the stage at Ramatuelle. Over the years, China Moses has become a mature performer with a unique style: rocky voice, sharp sense of swing, and intense/energetic stage presence.

programme.title: Recorda Me
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by.

programme.title: Dave Brubeck and Paul Desmond live in Belgium
programme.desc: Dave Brubeck: Live in '64 boasts a beautifully filmed concert from one of the most beloved quartets in jazz history.

programme.title: Live in Sydney
programme.desc: Steven Gene Wold, commonly known as Seasick Steve, (born circa 1941) is an American bluesman, although he prefers to be called 'a song and dance man'. He plays guitars (mostly personalized), and sings, usually about his early life living rough and doing casual work.

programme.title: Portrait of Roy Ayers
programme.desc: ‘The legend of the groove’ is a series of documentaries devoted to the musicians who were most influential on contemporary hip hop, soul, rhythm 'n' blues, and on the course of history. Between the late 1950s and now, these musicians radically changed music. Although sometimes hardly in the public eye, they have all been major sources of inspiration for today's major artists: Prince, Erykah Badu, Janis Joplin and Jimi Hendrix.

programme.title: Diminuendo in Blue and Crescendo in Blue
programme.desc: The Royal Concertgebouw in Amsterdam is a world-renowned concert hall, known for its first-rate acoustics. It has attracted many famous performers over the years and is one of the Netherlands' most treasured musical institutions. On November 2, 1958, American jazz titan Duke Ellington and his Orchestra performed two concerts at the Concertgebouw in Amsterdam.

programme.title: Adjustment
programme.desc: Legendary jazz pianist Horace Silver's groundbreaking fusion of hard bop, blues, soulful grooves and Cape Verdean influences have left an indelible mark on the world of jazz. At the renowned Umbria Jazz Festival in the picturesque region of Umbria, Italy, Silver is accompanied by a great band of future all-stars: Bob Berg on tenor sax, Tom Harrell on trumpet, Steve Beskrone on bass and Eddie Gladden on drums.

programme.title: Stingray PausePlay: Katie Melua
programme.desc: We Pause and chat with local and international artists to get an in-depth look at their lives and music, they Play some amazing music in these, one-of-a-kind, live sessions! These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life.

programme.title: Live at Beck’s Festival Bar
programme.desc: The UK based band Metronomy started out as a bedroom project by Joseph Mount, who during its early stages was the sole contributor to the band's repertoire. After the debut release, Mount started expanding the band's personnel: first by adding two members, and later increasing it by one more.

programme.title: BIRD - The Nest
programme.desc: Five promising musicians get together in Rotterdam jazz club BIRD’s artists-in-residence project “The Nest”. Over the course of seven sessions, these talents exchange ideas, work on their projects, and play music together. Following this period, during which record producer Jameszoo and music manager Jochem Tromp offer their coaching experience, BIRD and North Sea Jazz Festival’s fringe festival DownTown organize a tryout performance.

programme.title: PC Qwintett: 75th year of Courbois
programme.desc: Pierre Courbois has been one of Europe’s leading jazz musicians since the mid-sixties. This concert, recorded at the renowned Amsterdam jazz club Bimhuis, sees the drummer playing with his QWINTETT. On the occasion of his 75th birthday in 2015, Courbois hit the road for the Pierre Courbois 75 Years Anniversary Tour.

programme.title: MotorMusic Jazz Sessions: Nardozza - Bisceglia
programme.desc: The MotorMusic Studios in Mechelen, Belgium, attract many great musicians to the city. A wide variety of visiting international jazz musicians share their art of making jazz music with us in the DJAZZ series ‘Belgium Sessions’. In these sessions, some of Europe’s finest musicians perform their own, original music.

programme.title: Branford Marsalis Quartet - North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. In 1987, jazz saxophonist Branford Marsalis brought his band to the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague.

programme.title: Jazz Batá 2
programme.desc: Legendary Cuban pianist Chucho Valdés brought his band ‘Jazz Batá 2’ to the Malta Jazz Festival on July 19, 2019. The air was thick with anticipation as Valdés took to the stage, revisiting the small-group concept of his mythical 1972 Cuban album ‘Jazz Bata´’. The bata´ repertoire – the deep classical music of West Africa – permeates Valde´s’ piano solos throughout the concert.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Thomas Carbou: Spectacle Au Bleury
programme.desc: Thomas Carbou and Patrick Graham share an almost telepathic rapport, blending spontaneous improvisation, electronic looping, and Brazilian and Indian musical influences to create ecstatic groove pieces and dream-like soundscapes.

programme.title: Chamber music: Sissoko And Segal
programme.desc: Hailing from a long tradition of Malian kora players, Ballake Sissoko has worked with renowned musicians such as Toumani Diabaté and Taj Mahal. He met the French born Vincent Ségal by chance, and the two began jamming together, uncertain of what kind of music might result.

programme.title: Paradox Live: Jeroen van Vliet Moon Trio
programme.desc: Innovative contemporary jazz and improvised music, the search for modernity, mind blowing sounds, rock and pop… Indeed PARADOX Tilburg goes beyond jazz, crossing musical boundaries into the unknown soundscapes of electronic music. Indie artists, blues veterans and jazz superstars all pour their hearts and souls at the Paradox.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: Wynton Marsalis: In This House, on This Morning
programme.desc: The final concert of the Münchner Klaviersommer 1992 was by Wynton Marsalis and his septet. The 31-years-young star trumpeter performed one of his own jazz suites to the sold-out Philharmonie, under the title of ‘In This House, On This Morning’. The concert covers every jazz style, in composition and improvisation, and in both small and grand forms.

programme.title: North Sea Jazz Archive: Wayne Shorter Quartet
programme.desc: The world-renowned North Sea Jazz Festival features a wide variety of genres, including traditional New Orleans jazz, swing, bop, free jazz, fusion, avant-garde and electronic jazz, blues, gospel, funk, soul, RAndB, hip hop, world beat and Latin. The festival was founded by entrepreneur and jazz fan Paul Acket, who sold his highly successful pop magazine publishing house to organize and fund the first edition of the festival in 1976.

programme.title: The Morgenland Festival: VIVA!
programme.desc: Since 2005, the Morgenland Festival of Osnabrueck has dedicated itself to the fascinating music culture of the Near and Middle East. From traditional and classical music to avant-garde, jazz, and rock, the festival program also features art, such as visual arts, dance, and theatre of interdisciplinary projects. “Viva” is a perfect mixture of various instruments and musicians from all over the world.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Art Blakey And The Jazz Messengers - Olympia, Paris
programme.desc: The legendary hard-bop group Art Blakey's Jazz Messengers performed in Olympia Hall in Paris, France on March 16, 1963. Led by drummer Art Blakey, the Jazz Messengers consisted of Wayne Shorter on tenor saxophone, Freddie Hubbard on trumpet, Curtis Fuller on trombone, Reggie Workman on double bass, and Cedar Walton on piano. Each of these players became jazz legends in their own right.

programme.title: Respect to Aretha
programme.desc: To close its 2019 edition, Jazz à la Villette pays tribute to the queen of soul Aretha Franklin, who died in the summer of 2018. The musical direction of the evening has been entrusted to Antibalas, an Afrobeat group from Brooklyn attached to the Daptones label, accompanied for the occasion by several guest singers: Bettye LaVette, José James, Alice Russell, Nona Hendryx And Zara McFarlane.

programme.title: Artvark Saxophone Quartet And Ntjam Rosie: Homelands
programme.desc: Homelands is a collaboration between Artvark Saxophone Quartet and Cameroonian-Dutch singer Ntjam Rosie. The music is inspired by both traditional and modern music from Ntjam’s home country Cameroon, (Manu Dibango and Richard Bona) as well as by an Afro-European blend of soul, jazz, gospel and world music.

programme.title: Kurt Rosenwinkel meets Peter Beets Trio
programme.desc: The Dutch world-class jazz pianist Peter Beets has shared the stage with jazz greats like Chick Corea, Wynton Marsalis, “Toots” Thielemans, Elvin Jones, George Coleman, Johnny Griffin, Benny Golson and John Clayton. From birth, Beets was surrounded by music: he heard classical music from his mother, who is a music pedagogue, and he heard jazz from his father, who has a great fan of Oscar Peterson and Art Blakey.

programme.title: We Are Birds - La Ciotat
programme.desc: Nordic afro jazz project 'We Are Birds' saw the light between Finland and Africa, during a 2010 jam session in which Finnish jazz pianist Tuomas A. Turunen met African drummer-percussionist and urban griot Dimitri Reverchon. The two composers set their mind to exploring this hybrid genre, and found their perfect complement in bassist Emmanuel Soulignac, who brought his pop influences to the table.

programme.title: Buck Clayton - Radio Télévision Suisse 'Variétés'
programme.desc: In the second half of June 1965, during a prolonged European concert tour, American trumpeter Buck Clayton (1911–1991) played a residency at the Chikito, a club in Bern, Switzerland.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: TorTube: Tingvall Trio - Vägen
programme.desc: Jazz fans in television land have come to the right place for their dose of first-rate world jazz: TorTube! Jazz club De Tor in Enschede is one of Europe’s most authentic jazz venues, with an absolutely unique ambiance. Some of the best musicians from Holland and the rest of the world find their way to De Tor to perform for an appreciative audience of jazz fans.

programme.title: DJAZZ Portrait: Jarrod Lawson
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: jazzahead! 2023 interview
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: November Music: Jon Balke Siwan
programme.desc: Since 1993, the November Music Festival has been held every year at various locations in the Dutch city of 's-Hertogenbosch. Highlighting a variety of contemporary musical styles and contemporary composers, November Music is today one of the most important festivals dedicated to contemporary music in the Netherlands.

programme.title: Giants of Jazz Part 2 - 7th Newport Jazz Festival
programme.desc: The Newport Jazz Festival, first established in the North-American town of Newport, Rhode Island in the summer of 1954, has now grown to become one of the largest multi-day celebrations of jazz worldwide. It has resulted in numerous famous live albums from top-rate jazz stars, and has spawned several worldwide tours, including editions of the Newport Jazz Festival in Rotterdam, The Netherlands.

programme.title: Johanna Summer - jazzahead!
programme.desc: Annual trade fair, exhibition, and festival jazzahead! is one of the international jazz community's most important events. Hosted in Bremen, Germany, jazzahead! brings together musicians, bookers, agents, organizers, jazz experts, and music enthusiasts. Due to COVID-19, only half of the scheduled performances of the 2021 edition were actually recorded in Bremen.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Trio Chemirani: Dawâr
programme.desc: The veritable tombak virtuosos of Trio Chemirani, consisting of Chemirani Senior and Juniors, enrapture the Festival de Saintes. The tombak is a Persian percussion instrument, but its rhythms are universal. The Trio Chemirani’s music is accessible to all and will certainly resound with each listener. The members of the trio, Djamchid Chemirani (born in Teheran in 1942) and his two sons and pupils Keyvan and Bijan, are living in France.

programme.title: Les McCann: Live in New Orleans
programme.desc: Self-taught musician Les McCann became the international jazz superstar he is today after the release of his album “Swiss Movement” which he recorded in 1968 with the late Eddie Harris. Yet there is much more to this musician than that one record.

programme.title: Count Basie and his Orchestra live in Charleroi
programme.desc: Count Basie is one of the most important bandleaders of the swing era. With the exception of a brief period in the early '50s, he led a big band from 1935 until his death almost 50 years later. Basie's orchestra was characterized by a light, swinging rhythm section that he led from the piano, lively ensemble work, and generous soloing. Basie was not a composer like Duke Ellington or an important soloist like Benny Goodman.

programme.title: Bayerischer Hof Night Club: Maria João Quartet
programme.desc: In this recording, the Portuguese singer Maria João makes her appearance at the Bayerischer Hof Night Club during the 1999 Münchner Klaviersommer. She is accompanied by Marcio Doctor (percussion), Miroslav Tadic (guitar), and her long-standing partner, the brilliant pianist Mário Laginha. Maria is known for her vocal flexibility and improvisational skills.

programme.title: A l'origine Histoires
programme.desc: Frank Lalou est calligraphe, et il est surtout passionné par le sens des lettres.
